figures.title: Freeze the policy before any candidate
figures.desc: The policy is frozen first: hard gate, any single violation. Candidates stay closed until that policy is on disk.
figures.caption: Confirm hard gate, any single violation, before you open a candidate.
figures.transcript: The policy is frozen first: hard gate, any single violation. Candidates stay closed until that policy is on disk.

figures.title: Four kinds of evidence, not a blend
figures.desc: Deterministic case, repeated aggregated runs, hard gate, and a stochastic claim stay separate. A stochastic claim is excluded from adoption.
figures.caption: Keep deterministic, repeated, hard-gate, and stochastic evidence in separate columns.
figures.transcript: Deterministic case, repeated aggregated runs, hard gate, and a stochastic claim stay separate. A stochastic claim is excluded from adoption.

items.label: Deterministic case
items.detail: the same input, the same result

items.label: Repeated aggregated runs
items.detail: counted, not averaged into a gate

figures.title: Each candidate sits next to its baseline
figures.desc: Confirm both baselines pass. Then place each candidate next to its own baseline. Do not mix pairs.
figures.caption: Sit each candidate next to its own baseline.
figures.transcript: Confirm both baselines pass. Then place each candidate next to its own baseline. Do not mix pairs.

figures.title: One hard-gate miss defeats the candidate
figures.desc: A hard gate is any single violation. Defeat: do not average. Continue only if every gate holds.
figures.caption: One hard-gate miss defeats the candidate. Do not average.
figures.transcript: A hard gate is any single violation. Defeat: do not average. Continue only if every gate holds.

figures.title: Invented payload cannot be adopted
figures.desc: An invented payload is a hard-gate miss. The candidate cannot be adopted. The baseline without that payload still stands.
figures.caption: An invented payload is a hard-gate miss. Do not adopt that candidate.
figures.transcript: An invented payload is a hard-gate miss. The candidate cannot be adopted. The baseline without that payload still stands.

figures.title: 20:50Z is not 14:50 without both zones
figures.desc: Collapse is 20:50Z printed as 14:50. Allowed is both UTC and MDT written. One zone alone is a miss.
figures.caption: Both UTC and MDT must be written. 20:50Z printed as 14:50 is a miss.
figures.transcript: Collapse is 20:50Z printed as 14:50. Allowed is both UTC and MDT written. One zone alone is a miss.

items.label: Allowed
items.detail: both UTC and MDT are written

figures.title: The adoption claim cannot exceed the cases
figures.desc: The adoption claim names only the cases you ran. It does not extend to unseen pairs or to a quality average.
figures.caption: Bound the adoption claim to the cases you actually ran.
figures.transcript: The adoption claim names only the cases you ran. It does not extend to unseen pairs or to a quality average.

figures.title: A repair case cannot confirm the repair
figures.desc: A case used to find the defect cannot confirm that the defect is gone. Confirmation needs a case that was not used to diagnose.
figures.caption: Do not use the repair case as the confirmation case.
figures.transcript: A case used to find the defect cannot confirm that the defect is gone. Confirmation needs a case that was not used to diagnose.

items.label: Confirmation case
items.detail: a case not used to diagnose

figures.title: Remove the candidate and pass baseline again
figures.desc: Remove the candidate from the work copy. Restore the baseline. The baseline must pass again.
figures.caption: Remove the candidate and pass the baseline again.
figures.transcript: Remove the candidate from the work copy. Restore the baseline. The baseline must pass again.
